title: CrochetVsKnittingImageRecord
description: One labelled image record for the crochet-vs-knitting classification experiment. Not implemented as a Pydantic model yet - this is the design-time schema; a typed loader may be added when data collection actually begins.

record_id.description: Unique ID for this specific image (one physical object may have many record_ids).

object_id.description: Unique ID for the physical object photographed. THE grouping key for train/test splitting - see split-policy.md. Every image of the same physical beanie/swatch/garment must share this ID.

class_label.description: 'uncertain' is a first-class label, not a missing value - use it whenever a confident human annotator would not commit to one of the other four.

view_type.description: macro = close enough to see individual stitch structure (target: >=20px across an average stitch); full_object = whole item visible.

device_type.description: e.g. 'smartphone_rear', 'smartphone_front', 'dslr', 'scanner'. Free text, not an enum - device diversity is a coverage axis, not a constraint.

focus_quality.description: Blurry examples must be deliberately included, not filtered out - see annotation-guide.md.

yarn_colour_category.description: 'fuzzy_low_contrast' covers mohair/eyelash-type yarns where stitch definition is inherently hard to see regardless of focus.

distance_category.description: Optional. Distant examples stress-test the classifier's honest use of the uncertain class.

confidence.description: The ANNOTATOR's confidence in their own label, independent of any model's later confidence score.

second_annotator_id.description: Populated only for the inter-annotator-agreement sample - see annotation-guide.md.

disagreement_resolved_by.description: Adjudicator ID, only populated if the two annotators disagreed.

source_type.description: Per the source decision package's licence audit, a licensed dataset entry (e.g. CrochetBench, CC BY-NC 4.0) must record its licence terms in license_note and must not be treated as commercially reusable without separate review.

consent_reference.description: Pointer to a consent record for own_capture images. Required and non-null when source_type is own_capture.

split.description: Assigned by the split-generation process (split-policy.md), never by the annotator. All images sharing an object_id must have the same split value.
